title: Own a piece
intro: A stock makes you a part owner of a company. This Lesson shows what you get and what you risk. It also shows how spreading your money lowers that risk.

check.prompt: A company's stock price can only go up.
check.explanation: Myth. Stock prices go down as well as up, and you can lose money.

check.prompt: Mai puts $100 in each of ten companies, and one company's stock falls by half. How much of her $1,000 does she lose?
check.explanation: $50. Only $100 was in that company, so one fall matters less.

check.prompt: A fund that holds only one industry is always well diversified.
check.explanation: Myth. A fund focused on one industry may still not be diversified.
